method: Independent Decimal filtering of the previously frozen prescribed economic journals. No production code, API result, browser result or actual nil-return record inspected. The frozen year-end case expressly has no December-March activity.

controls.nilIsNotNoReturn: A registered company with monthly filing still prepares a nil return for each prescribed no-activity period. Retaining a draft does not submit that return to IRD.
controls.retention: Each exact period must retain its own draft and canonical calculation snapshot. Do not reuse another period, fabricate a filed confirmation or mutate a prior filed record.
controls.webChronology: After a March31 fiscal close, an owner reopens from December1 with a reviewed audit reason, prepares four nil drafts and recloses March31. Closing/reopening changes cutoff revision/audit only. Existing closed-date tax-draft guard remains intact.
controls.mobileChronology: Prepare all four nil drafts before the first March31 fiscal close. The difference in cutoff audit history does not change financial/GST expectations.
controls.historicalFinance: All seven financial sections, raw journal count and source journal amounts remain unchanged across nil-draft preparation and metadata-only close/reopen/reclose.
controls.bankStatements: Existing completed December1-March31 zero-activity bank statement is supporting evidence, not a GST filing. Reopening the fiscal cutoff does not remove its independent cash cutoff.
controls.clock: Controlled test date May1,2027 permits all four completed calendar periods; no production future-date policy change.
